parameters.expression: const double fourPi = 4 * constants::pi; adjustedAngle = positiveMod(m_plugs[i].angle - advance, fourPi)
parameters.units: radians (720° four-stroke cycle if constants::pi is π)
parameters.whatItDoes: Detects per-cylinder cycle-angle crossings after ignition advance and emits ignitionEvent flags.

parameters.expression: m_plugs[cylinderIndex].angle = angle; m_plugs[cylinderIndex].enabled = true
parameters.whatItDoes: Assigns a fixed firing angle to a cylinder plug.

parameters.expression: revLimit = units::rpm(6000.0); limiterDuration = 0.5 * units::sec
parameters.units: revLimit in angular speed after units::rpm; duration in seconds after units::sec
parameters.whatItDoes: Default rev-limit threshold and cut duration when script does not override.

parameters.expression: if (m_enabled && m_revLimitTimer == 0) { /* emit events */ } ; if (fabs(v_theta) > m_revLimit) m_revLimitTimer = m_limiterDuration
parameters.units: seconds for timer; revLimit units unknown without units.h
parameters.whatItDoes: Gates all ignition events while the limiter timer is active after overspeed.
Configures one cross-plane V8 example with even 90° ignition spacing and classic firing order.

parameters.expression: samples: 0–1000 rpm → 12°; 2000→20°; 3000→30°; 4000–8000→40°; rev_limit 6800 rpm; limiter_duration 0.2
parameters.units: degrees / rpm via script units; limiter duration likely seconds
parameters.whatItDoes: Example spark advance map and limiter for the GM LS script only.

parameters.expression: b0 cylinders → exhaust0; b1 cylinders → exhaust1; exhaust0.length=100*inch; exhaust1.length=172*inch; primary_tube_length=29*inch; per-cylinder primary_length unequal
parameters.whatItDoes: Routes bank cylinders to two collectors with unequal exhaust and primary lengths.

parameters.expression: delay = (headerPrimaryLength + exhaustLength) / (343.0 * units::m / units::sec); delayFilters[i].initialize(delay, 10000.0)
parameters.units: seconds for delay if length is metres
parameters.whatItDoes: Initialises one integer delay line per cylinder from geometric exhaust path length.

parameters.expression: attenuation=min(|filteredEngineSpeed|,40)/40; attenuation_3=attenuation^3; exhaustFlow=attenuation_3*1600*((P-atm)+0.1*dyn(+x)+0.1*dyn(-x)); staging[collector]+=soundAttenuation*(audioVolume*delayedPulse/cylinderCount)*(1/(exhaustLength^2))
parameters.units: native audio staging units; not Web Audio float calibrated
parameters.whatItDoes: Builds per-collector audio inputs from delayed runner pressure pulses with speed and length attenuation.

parameters.expression: kineticEnergy() / (0.5 * m_degreesOfFreedom * volume())
parameters.whatItDoes: Computes static pressure from kinetic energy, degrees of freedom, and volume.

parameters.expression: staticPressure * (sqrt(x_d) - 1) for x = 1 + ((hcr-1)/2)*mach^2 with dof-dependent x_d
parameters.units: same pressure domain as static pressure
parameters.whatItDoes: Direction-sensitive dynamic pressure from momentum and local sound speed.

parameters.expression: volume=1; convolution=1; dF_F_mix=0.01; inputSampleNoise=0.5; inputSampleNoiseFrequencyCutoff=10000; airNoise=1; airNoiseFrequencyCutoff=2000; levelerTarget=30000; levelerMaxGain=1.9; levelerMinGain=1e-5
parameters.whatItDoes: Default post-mix DSP controls for derivative/air-noise blend, convolution amount, and leveling.

parameters.expression: f = f_in - dc(f_in); f_p = derivative(f_in); v_in = f_p*dF_F_mix + f*(airNoise*LPF(noise)+(1-airNoise))*(1-dF_F_mix); v = convAmount*conv(v_in)+(1-convAmount)*v_in; then antialias, level, int16 clip
parameters.whatItDoes: Per-channel DC removal, derivative mix, amplitude noise, convolution, sum, antialias, level, hard clip to int16.

parameters.expression: m_simulationFrequency=10000; m_targetSynthesizerLatency=0.1; audioSampleRate=44100; inputSampleRate=getSimulationFrequency(); inputChannelCount=exhaustSystemCount
parameters.whatItDoes: Sets simulation input rate, audio output rate, channel count from exhaust systems, and ~100 ms latency target.

parameters.expression: samples = round(delay * audioFrequency); write then read after latencySamples
parameters.whatItDoes: Integer ring-buffer delay; returns 0 until filled.

parameters.expression: (sample - previous) / m_dt with m_dt = 1/audioSampleRate
parameters.whatItDoes: First difference scaled by sample period; sample-rate dependent HF gain.

parameters.expression: LPF(random * maxJitter) fractional index into circular history
parameters.whatItDoes: Adds filtered fractional delay jitter to input samples.

parameters.expression: direct FIR against shift register; IR length capped at 10000 in initializeImpulseResponse
parameters.whatItDoes: Loads and applies per-channel impulse responses in the time domain.
dependencies: impulse response assets not in package

parameters.expression: clutch torque ± maxClutchTorque * clutchPressure; gear change sets rotating mass inertia from tire/(diff*gear)
parameters.units: torque via units::torque defaults 1000 ft_lb in ctor
parameters.whatItDoes: Applies clutch constraint torque and remaps driveline inertia on gear change.

parameters.expression: simulation_frequency: 10000; hf_gain: 0.01; noise: 1.0; jitter: 0.6; redline: 6500 * units.rpm
parameters.units: Hz; other gains unitless in script
parameters.whatItDoes: Example engine audio/simulation knobs for GM LS only.
dependencies: engine node implementation not fully extracted
